verdict.rationale: Together AI's own docs say users can fine-tune supported base models on their own data, using either LoRA or full fine-tuning, and launch jobs from the console, API/SDK or CLI. The docs also say the result can be served on a dedicated endpoint, with the platform handling the full lifecycle from data upload through training, hosting and inference. Missing for 10: independent hands-on or community corroboration of the fine-tune-to-serve workflow.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can fine-tune a supported base model on my own data and serve the result on the same platform

citations.quote: Fine-tune models on your own data and deploy them for inference.
Fine-tuned models: Deploy a model you fine-tuned from a supported base model.
Together AI handles the full lifecycle: data upload, training, hosting, and inference on a dedicated endpoint.
You can launch a fine-tuning job from the console, through the API/SDK, or with the CLI
LoRA: Trains a small set of adapter weights on top of the frozen base model... Full fine-tuning: Updates every weight in the base model.
